SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(ds.points) FROM driverStandings ds WHERE ds.driverId=d.driverId) AS maxpts
FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON r.driverId=d.driverId
WHERE r.position=1
GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.laps=w.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct
FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=r.driverId
JOIN results w ON w.raceId=r.raceId AND w.position=1
WHERE d.nationality='Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId=r.constructorId
WHERE ra.name='Monaco Grand Prix' AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(n),2)FROM (
SELECT ra.raceId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitStops p WHERE p.raceId=ra.raceId) AS n
FROM races ra WHERE ra.year=2017 AND ra.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM races WHERE year=2000))

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob, COUNT(q.q3) AS q3count
FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId=d.driverId AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3<>''
WHERE d.nationality='German' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY q3count DESC, d.dob ASC

WITH t AS (SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1,
 CAST(substr(q.q1,1,instr(q.q1,':')-1) AS INT)*60000 + CAST(substr(q.q1,instr(q.q1,':')+1,2) AS INT)*1000 + CAST(substr(q.q1,instr(q.q1,'.')+1) AS INT) AS ms
 FROM qualifying q JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=q.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=q.driverId
 WHERE ra.year=1995 AND ra.name='Japanese Grand Prix' AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1<>'')
SELECT forename, surname, q1 FROM t WHERE ms=(SELECT MIN(ms) FROM t WHERE ms>0 AND ms<300000)

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS n
FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=r.driverId
WHERE ra.name='Italian Grand Prix' AND r.position=2
GROUP BY d.forename HAVING n>=2 ORDER BY n DESC, d.forename ASC

SELECT ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=q.driverId WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3<>'' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31')
 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'),2)

WITH best AS (
 SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS ms FROM lapTimes l GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId HAVING MIN(l.milliseconds) > 90000)
SELECT ra.date, d.forename, d.surname,
 CASE WHEN b.ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (b.ms/60000) || ':' || printf('%02d', (b.ms%60000)/1000) || '.' || printf('%03d', b.ms%1000) END AS fastest_lap
FROM races ra LEFT JOIN best b ON b.raceId=ra.raceId LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=b.driverId
WHERE ra.name='French Grand Prix' AND ra.year>=1990
ORDER BY ra.date, d.surname, d.forename, b.ms
note: results.fastestLapTime has none >90s; used per-driver best lapTimes; 255: Blundell q1 16:42.640 is a data outlier, excluded by <5min cap

WITH w AS (SELECT d.* FROM drivers d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results r WHERE r.driverId=d.driverId AND r.positionOrder=1) ORDER BY d.dob ASC, d.forename||' '||d.surname ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT w.forename||' '||w.surname AS full_name, w.nationality,
 (SELECT ra.name FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId WHERE r.driverId=w.driverId AND r.positionOrder=1 ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name LIMIT 1) AS first_win_race,
 (SELECT ra.date FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId WHERE r.driverId=w.driverId AND r.positionOrder=1 ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name LIMIT 1) AS first_win_date,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId=w.driverId) AS races_started
FROM w

WITH t AS (SELECT d.surname, ra.name AS race, q.q2,
 CAST(substr(q.q2,1,instr(q.q2,':')-1) AS INT)*60000 + CAST(substr(q.q2,instr(q.q2,':')+1,2) AS INT)*1000 + CAST(substr(q.q2,instr(q.q2,'.')+1) AS INT) AS ms
 FROM qualifying q JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=q.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId=q.driverId
 WHERE ra.year=2017 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2<>'')
SELECT surname, race FROM t WHERE ms=(SELECT MIN(ms) FROM t)
